cards.title: Media app
cards.description: Open a configured source on the selected media player.
notes: Choose App logo independently of the launch source: Automatic, Netflix, Spotify, YouTube, Disney+, Prime Video, Apple TV, Plex, MEO, HBO Max or F1 TV. Artwork ships with Marao. Automatic matches the source (including MEO Go); an unrecognized source keeps your fallback icon. Choosing a logo does not change what the player opens.

For a standalone shortcut, use `variables.app_logo`:

```yaml
type: custom:marao-media-app-card
entity_id: media_player.living_room
name: Custom TV app
icon: mdi:television
variables:
  app_source: Custom TV app
  app_logo: netflix
```

In a Media card’s Apple TV options, each app has the same chooser. Its `logo` becomes the shortcut’s artwork in popup and inline layouts:

```yaml
apple_tv:
  apps:
    - name: Custom TV app
      source: Custom TV app
      icon: mdi:television
      logo: netflix
```

Omit the option or choose Automatic to restore matching. Valid IDs are `netflix`, `spotify`, `youtube`, `disney-plus`, `prime-video`, `apple-tv`, `plex`, `meo`, `hbo-max` and `f1-tv`. The source must exactly match an app supported by your player.
